tasks.title: Create version.ts module with getVersionInfo()
tasks.description: Create `packages/cli/src/version.ts` exporting `getVersionInfo()` that returns `{ version, gitHash, versionString }`. Version reads from package.json. Git hash via `execSync('git rev-parse --short HEAD')` relative to the module's directory, with null fallback on failure. Result cached in module-level variable.
acceptanceCriteria: getVersionInfo() returns { version: string, gitHash: string|null, versionString: string }
versionString is '{version} ({gitHash})' when gitHash available, else '{version}'
Result is cached — second call returns same object without spawning git again

tasks.title: Wire CLI --version to getVersionInfo()
tasks.description: In `packages/cli/src/cli/index.ts`, import `getVersionInfo` from `../version` and replace `.version('0.1.0')` with `.version(getVersionInfo().versionString)`. Commander prints this on `mo --version`.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo --version` outputs format like `0.1.0 (abc1234)` instead of bare `0.1.0`

tasks.title: Add version to server startup log and status/health API
tasks.description: Three changes: (1) In `server/index.ts`, import getVersionInfo and add `log.info('Mohist v{versionString} starting...')` as first log after Log.init. (2) Pass versionInfo to createStatusRoutes as a new parameter. (3) In `api/status.ts`, add `version` and `gitHash` fields to both `/status` response data and `/health` response JSON. Update createStatusRoutes signature to accept versionInfo.
acceptanceCriteria: Server startup first log line contains 'Mohist v' and version+hash
GET /api/health returns { status, timestamp, version, gitHash }
GET /api/status response data includes version and gitHash fields

tasks.title: Add version line to mo server status output
tasks.description: In `packages/cli/src/cli/commands/server.ts` serverStatus(), when server is running, call GET /api/health to fetch version info and print a `Version: {versionString}` line (gray). If health fetch fails, skip the version line. For systemd path, call GET /api/health similarly when active.
acceptanceCriteria: `mo server status` shows `Version: 0.1.0 (abc1234)` line when server is running
No version line shown when server is not running

tasks.title: Add version info block to WebUI Settings General
tasks.description: In `GeneralSettingsSection.tsx`, add a version info block at the bottom (after Reset button). Fetch from GET /api/health via useEffect+useState. Display version and gitHash in gray text. Show '--' while loading or on fetch failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings > General shows version number and git hash at bottom
Version block uses low visual weight (gray text)
Shows '--' or loading state while fetching or on failure
